name: tabiji.ai Travel API
description: Free AI-curated travel data — destinations, itineraries, comparisons, country facts, alerts, scam guides, and unified search for 6,498+ destinations. No API key required.

skills.name: Plan a Trip
skills.description: Get detailed day-by-day travel itineraries with activities, neighborhoods, logistics, and timing. Covers 399 itineraries across 6,498+ destinations worldwide.
examples: I need a honeymoon itinerary for Bali

skills.name: Compare Destinations
skills.description: Compare two destinations head-to-head across food, culture, cost, transport, seasonality, and fit. Includes Reddit quotes, data-backed category breakdowns, and a final verdict. Covers 867 destination comparisons.

skills.name: Discover Destinations
skills.description: Browse and filter 6,498 travel destinations by region, budget ($–$$$$), season, vibes (City, Beach, Nature, Cultural, Nightlife, etc.), and travel style (solo, family, photography, etc.). Each destination includes a pitch, editorial summary, related itineraries, and comparisons.
examples: Warm places for a March trip
